meta.title: POSMTRADE — POS materials and cardboard displays
meta.description: POSMTRADE designs and manufactures cardboard displays, stands and POS materials for retail: from engineering and 3D mock-up to printing, assembly and delivery.

hero.title: We make your product stand out on the shelf
hero.lead: We engineer and manufacture cardboard displays, stands and POS materials that sell — from the idea and 3D mock-up to print, assembly and delivery to the store. One partner all the way.

services.title: Everything that helps sell at the point of sale
services.intro: Every piece is engineered for a specific product, shelf and store — sturdy, quick to assemble and good-looking.

steps.title: 3D mock-up
steps.text: We show how the assembled piece will look before anything is printed.

steps.title: Print and die‑cut
steps.text: Full-color print, lamination and die‑cutting to the approved artwork.

steps.title: Assembly and packing
steps.text: We check a sample and pack it in shipping boxes with instructions.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: We ship the batch and the paperwork — without back-and-forth emails or manual paperwork.

about.title: End-to-end POS production under one roof
about.intro: POSMTRADE engineers and manufactures cardboard displays, stands and POS materials for brands and retail chains. Structural design, 3D mock-up, print, die-cutting, assembly and logistics work as one team — nothing gets lost between suppliers, and one partner answers for deadlines and quality.

items.title: Designed around your product
items.text: We calculate parts, locks and loads for the weight and size of your product — the stand stays straight for the whole campaign.

items.title: 3D before print
items.text: You approve a realistic 3D model with your artwork — changes happen before production, not after.

items.title: In-house production
items.text: Printing, lamination, die-cutting and assembly in our own production — no passing responsibility to subcontractors.

items.title: Every batch checked
items.text: Before shipping we assemble and check a sample; the batch leaves in transport packaging with instructions.

items.title: Fast start
items.text: We reply quickly and propose the first structure right at the start of the project.

items.title: Sustainable material
items.text: Corrugated board is light and recyclable: after the campaign the display goes to recycling, not to landfill.

cta.title: Got a product that needs to stand out?
cta.text: Send a photo of the product, its size and quantity — we'll propose a structure, show it in 3D and quote the batch.

faq.title: What clients usually ask before ordering

items.q: How much does a display cost?
items.a: It depends on the structure, print and quantity. Send the product, its size and quantity — we'll quote the batch.
We agree the run for your project — from a pilot batch to a chain-wide campaign.
It depends on the structure and quantity. We give the exact lead time with the quote — and keep it.

items.q: Can I see the display before print?
items.a: Yes: we show a 3D mock-up with your artwork and, if needed, an assembled sample.
We work with your artwork or adapt it to the die-line, and check the files before print.

items.q: Will a shelf hold heavy products?
items.a: We calculate the structure for the product weight and reinforce shelves with extra layers for heavy goods.
Yes. We pack in transport packaging with assembly instructions and ship the batch with its documents.
